next_step_summary: PR #236 adds the first repository-safe Question Engine golden fixture from one owner-controlled real three-page Hebrew residential rental contract. Only sanitized printed legal text and metadata are persisted; source photos, raw OCR, person names, Israeli IDs, phone numbers, full addresses, bank/account/branch details, signatures, handwriting and stamp content are excluded. Handwriting is not transcribed, reconstructed or inferred. The fixture preserves printed monetary amounts, dates, clause numbering, blanks and apparent source inconsistencies without normalization. Contract roles remain collective המשכיר/השוכר by default, but clause 24 provides a concrete exception: the operative printed text distinguishes two members of the tenant party by name and assigns different payment behavior, so those two references alone are anonymized as TENANT_A and TENANT_B. This confirms the rule that individual party placeholders are introduced only when the contract itself materially distinguishes individuals. The next bounded step is question-engine-question-inventory-v1: derive the first recurring/conditional question inventory and evidence targets from this sanitized fixture without adding Gemini/runtime integration.
